image_description: A low-angle interior shot of a grand, ornate Baroque-style high altar within a church. The structure features massive twisted columns (Solomonic columns), a central niche containing a statue, and elaborate gilded decorations. A smaller, simpler table altar with a white cloth is visible in the immediate foreground. The background shows a domed ceiling with windows letting in natural light.
